title: Banco De Talentos Gft - Desenvolvimento Front-End React
description:

title: React Tech Lead
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for React Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Build a framework for other developers to build applications with. Initially focusing on building reactive dashboards with an option to make mobile versions of them.

- Assist in coaching and mentoring other React developers.


Requirements:


- 7+ years of experience in Front End development with strong skills in Javascript, CSS3 and HTML5.

- 2+ of experience developing Web applications using ReactJS, Flux, Redux, Relay, etc.

- Experience using ES2015 (ES6 / ES7).

- Experience with command lines, APIs, and client-side performance.

- Familiar with the concepts of basic programming, JavaScript and data structures, types of variables and idiosyncrasies.

- Comfortable using debuggers and code tracking.

- Proven experience in the use of Jasmine or similar tools for Front End testing.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Content Reviewer
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning talent network , and we are currently looking for a Content Reviewer to review and evaluate online content to help improve AI responses and overall accuracy. The role involves checking content quality, correctness, and proper categorization according to project guidelines.

If you enjoy working with data, pay close attention to detail, and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is an excellent opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking global team.


Job Title: Content Reviewer

Location: Remote /Brazil

Type: Freelance

Required Engagement: 30 hours per week


Key Responsibilities:

- Review digital content and evaluate its quality and accuracy

- Help improve AI responses by providing accurate evaluations

- Follow project guidelines while reviewing content

- Identify errors, inconsistencies, or inappropriate content

- Categorize and tag content appropriately


Key Requirements:

- Good knowledge of pop culture, brands, and current events

- Understanding of taxonomy and content categorization

- Familiarity with social media platforms is mandatory

- Strong attention to detail and communication skills


Assessment Process:

Candidates will be required to complete the following assessments:

- LLM Evaluation Assessment

- Pearson Versant Assessment (C1/C2 only)

- ICAP MRS Assessment (link will be shared soon)


Candidates who successfully pass all three assessments will be invited for a short interview with the project team .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious, and eager to make an impact in the world of AI, we’d love to have you join our growing network.

title: Gerente Financeiro
description:
A Lola From Rio vem crescendo e revolucionando o mundo dos cosméticos e, para acompanhar este crescimento, estamos com oportunidades para você que é apaixonado(a) por beleza.


Nosso time Financeiro está com oportunidade para você que deseja aplicar seus conhecimentos e desenvolver habilidades em uma empresa que vem revolucionando o mercado de cosméticos no Brasil e no exterior.


Escolha Lola, Escolha Ser Feliz!


Cargo: Gerente Financeiro


Missão do cargo

Responsável pela gestão integrada das atividades de tesouraria, contas a pagar e contas a receber, crédito e cobrança, assegurando o controle eficiente do fluxo de caixa, a liquidez da companhia, níveis adequados de inadimplência e a correta execução das obrigações financeiras.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Principais Responsabilidades:


Gestão de Tesouraria

• Elaborar a posição de caixa, fluxo de caixa (direto e indireto) e indicadores financeiros, acompanhando projeções de curto, médio e longo prazo.

• Monitorar e controlar a posição diária de caixa, garantindo a disponibilidade de recursos para as operações.

• Gerenciar aplicações financeiras de curto prazo, resgates e movimentações bancárias.

• Acompanhar e negociar operações de empréstimos e financiamentos.

• Manter relacionamento operacional com instituições financeiras, adquirentes e empresas de meios de pagamento.

• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na gestão do capital de giro e otimização da liquidez.


Contas a Pagar

• Supervisionar o processamento e a execução de pagamentos a fornecedores, tributos e demais obrigações financeiras.

• Garantir a correta validação, aprovação e programação dos pagamentos.

• Monitorar prazos e políticas internas, evitando atrasos ou penalidades.

• Controlar e acompanhar provisões financeiras e compromissos futuros.


Contas a Receber, Crédito e Cobrança

• Acompanhar os processos de crédito e cobrança de clientes.

• Monitorar a inadimplência e o aging de contas a receber.

• Apoiar estratégias de cobrança e negociação com clientes.

• Contribuir para a melhoria do ciclo de conversão de caixa.

• Utilizar informações de bureau de crédito para análise.

• Analisar demonstrações financeiras para definição de limites de crédito.

• Atuar na definição e revisão de políticas de crédito.

• Gerenciar processos de cobrança interna e externa.

• Implementar ferramentas de automação nos processos de contas a receber, crédito e cobrança.


Governança e Controles

• Monitorar indicadores como prazo médio de recebimento (DSO), prazo médio de pagamento (DPO) e ciclo financeiro.

• Garantir o cumprimento das políticas financeiras e controles internos.

• Apoiar os processos de fechamento financeiro e contábil, incluindo conciliações das áreas de tesouraria, AP e AR.

• Atuar em auditorias internas e externas.

• Garantir a rastreabilidade e documentação das transações financeiras.


Requisitos:

• Graduação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida em tesouraria, contas a pagar e contas a receber.

• Excel avançado.

• Experiência com sistemas ERP (SAP).


Desejável:

• Inglês avançado.

• Conhecimento em Power BI.

• Vivência em indústrias ou empresas de bens de consumo.


Regime de Trabalho: CLT - Segunda à sexta-feira (100% presencial)

Região de Atuação: Jacarepaguá | Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: Líder de Logística e Planejamento de Demanda
description:
A SoEnergy é um fornecedor global de Energy as a Service , garantindo soluções personalizadas para uma ampla gama de organizações e indústrias em todo o mundo.


Estamos com uma oportunidade para: Líder de Logística e Planejamento de Demanda – Rio de Janeiro (RJ)


Breve resumo da posição:

Esta posição tem papel estratégico na liderança das operações logísticas e do planejamento de demanda, sendo responsável por transformar a área de logística de um modelo transacional para um modelo estratégico. Atuará na definição e implementação da estratégia logística, otimização de fluxos inbound e outbound, gestão de fornecedores críticos e integração com áreas-chave do negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, competitividade de custos e suporte ao crescimento da empresa.


O que buscamos (requisitos necessários)?

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência sólida em logística em empresas multinacionais;
  • Atuação prévia em posição de liderança na área de logística;
  • Forte conhecimento em logística inbound e outbound, comércio exterior e fluxos industriais de produção;
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP, como SAP e/ou Totvs;
  • Vivência tanto no lado cliente quanto fornecedor em operações logísticas (ex.: portos, freight forwarders – exceto despachante aduaneiro);
  • Inglês em nível avançado.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de logística e supervisionar as atividades de todas as equipes logísticas.
  • Construir operações de transporte confiáveis e competitivas em custos.
  • Gerenciar contratos e entregáveis de Freight Forwarders, Despachantes Aduaneiros e demais fornecedores da cadeia de transporte.
  • Definir e implementar a estratégia e os KPIs para mobilização e desmobilização de equipamentos.
  • Desenhar e implementar as tecnologias e os sistemas de informação logística da empresa, visando aumentar eficiência, rentabilidade, crescimento e nível de serviço ao cliente.
  • Identificar e solucionar ineficiências de rotas.
  • Implementar o processo de planejamento de demanda para atender às previsões de vendas.
  • Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque.
  • Assegurar conformidade com as regulamentações de transporte e comércio internacional.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de logística, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos logísticos.
  • Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
  • Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.
  • Transformar o departamento de Logística de transacional para tático e, posteriormente, de tático para estratégico.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de compras, manutenção e operações para previsão de demanda e otimização de estoques.


Local de trabalho:

  • Local: Centro - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

description:
Empresa de grande porte, busca Pessoa com Deficiência (PcD) para atuar em atividades de acompanhamento de performance, análise de dados e apoio à gestão.

A pessoa contratada atuará no acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), análise de resultados e suporte à construção de planos de ação, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e para a tomada de decisão das áreas envolvidas.

• Apoiar a elaboração e o controle de planos de ação

• Realizar análises comparativas entre resultados planejados e realizados

• Contribuir para o alinhamento entre áreas internas e parceiros

• Analisar processos e rotinas operacionais

• Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, otimização e automatização


Requisitos

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas

• Experiência prévia com análise de dados e indicadores

• Vivência na elaboração de relatórios e materiais de apoio à tomada de decisão

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e apresentação de dados (Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint)

title: Regional Sales Executive
description:
We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management : Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil.
  • Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Affiliate Onboarding : Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance.
  • Market Insights & Strategy : Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies.
  • Sales & Affiliate Reporting : Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts.
  • Administrative & Organizational Support : Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports.
  • Event Coordination : Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied.
  • Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships.

title: Consultor SAP Concur
description:
Temos 3 vagas disponível para essa posição, com diferentes senioridades: Pleno, Sênior e Especialista. Vem fazer parte do time!!!


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho (Pode variar de acordo com as posições):

  • Atuar em processos de despesas (Expense), viagens corporativas (Travel) e contas a pagar (Invoice), de acordo com as instruções do cliente;
  • Apoiar usuários e aprovadores em dúvidas operacionais e uso da solução (web e mobile);
  • Realizar ajustes e configurações usuais na plataforma conforme orientações do cliente;
  • Produzir materiais simples (guias rápidos, FAQs) e registros quando solicitado;
  • Sinalizar riscos ou inconsistências observadas, encaminhando ao gestor do cliente.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Concur;
  • Graduação completa.


Onde você vai trabalhar?:

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo.


Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end)
  • Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components
  • Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models
  • SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data


Plusses

  • Experience with C++ development
  • Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes


Day-to-Day

You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.

  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Professor de Espanhol

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

title: Technical Support Analyst (SAP ATLAS)
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail‑oriented IT Technical Support Engineer to join our ATLAS (Automation of Customer Life Cycle across SAP) team.

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting the end‑to‑end lifecycle of SAP solution landscapes for enterprise customers — from onboarding through offboarding. You’ll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‑quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, collaboration, and ownership , and who thrives in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow )
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.g., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‑facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement


Nice to Have


  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‑driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions , ideally SAP‑related.


Please submite resumé in English

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We’re looking for a high-output Social Media Manager to manage and scale a multi-platform presence across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd TikTok/IG/YouTube accounts, while handling community, growth hacking, and strategic outreach.


This is not a basic posting job — you’ll be responsible for running an entire content ecosystem, growing brand authority, and increasing reach through multi-language posting, cross-platform virality, and strategic relationship building.


We do not look for resumes - we only look for responses - fill this out:



✅ Responsibilities:


Platform Management


  • Warm up new TikTok/IG accounts using safe, proven methods (device + IP hygiene, watch time farming, etc.)
  • Run and manage 2nd and 3rd TikTok/IG/YT channels as clones with unique variation
  • Post daily on all socials, including:

  • TikTok (main + burner accounts)
  • Instagram (Reels + Feed)
  • YouTube (Shorts + Long form)
  • Twitter/X
  • Threads
  • Whop
  • Use Trial Reels or other tools for automated reel deployment & A/B testing


Whop Account Management


  • Post and manage Whop page & community
  • Keep offers updated, moderate access, and keep the page converting
  • Build Discord/Telegram (if needed) to support community management


Outreach & Guest Booking


  • Email 20–50 podcasts / influencers per week to pitch appearances or collabs
  • Track and schedule inbound interest
  • Draft outreach templates and continually optimize response rates


Promotion & Paid Growth


  • Identify top TikTok/IG pages for paid promo
  • Execute $10–$100 daily promos on viral accounts
  • Track ROI from shoutouts, reposts, and growth boosts


 Qualifications:


  • Proven experience growing multi-channel social media brands
  • Strong understanding of TikTok growth strategies, including warmup methods and shadowban prevention
  • Experience with posting tools like Metricool, Later, Hootsuite, etc.
  • Comfortable managing up to 5–7 sub-accounts at once
  • Familiarity with Whop or similar community/payment platforms
  • Organized, proactive, and consistent in follow-through
  • Bonus: Can write captions, titles, and CTAs that actually convert

title: Video Editor

About Us:

Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Our innovative technology supports our international community and gives our members a world-class survey taking experience.

Our mission is to match our authentic members to our client's market research surveys which allows our clients to achieve meaningful insights from the sample we deliver via online quantitative research. Members are rewarded with meaningful incentives, ensuring their sincere participation.

Nice to have

  • Fully remote — work from wherever

Important Notice

❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects . This is a full-time position .

❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;


Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.


Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:

Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

description:

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. description:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

title: Account Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
